title: Formalize rules-pack compiler & executable-curation architecture (ADR + guide + agent guidance)
description: The historical SRD 'importer' has evolved into a source-grounded rules compiler and executable curation system. Playtesting showed the pack must be a semantic substrate for the agreed model/engine execution boundary, not just a reference corpus. Make this durable architecture: (A) a new ADR that refines ADR 0007 (preserving its source-authority rule); (B) a canonical guide docs/rules-pack-compiler.md; (C) concise agent-guidance updates in packages/core/scripts/importers/AGENTS.md, docs/importer-fix-protocol.md, and the root AGENTS.md pointer. Documentation-only: no generated pack records, no importer refactor, no schema/engine/Pathfinder implementation. Must give a future agent a clear decision hierarchy for: parser vs declarative curated spec vs procedural projection vs model adjudication vs engine dependency, and the grounding evidence each requires.
design: Preserve ADR 0007 source-authority + model-assistance boundary; refine the reference-completeness-first framing. Use current execution-boundary vocabulary (code-enforced/model-adjudicated-supported/partial/implementation-required/design-blocked, families F1-F10/D1-D2), the three-layer magic-item state contract, and the rule-disposition/coverage registers. Terminology: rules-pack compiler / executable curation / importer (existing paths) / curator. No mass rename during the thaw.
acceptance_criteria: ADR created at next available number cross-referencing 0007; canonical guide added; three agent files updated concisely with no duplicated policy block; all internal links resolve; npm run check + hidden-unicode pass; no generated pack artifact or freeze manifest changed; PR opened targeting main.
